title: llama.cpp Releases v0.9.0 With Support for Native FP8 and Multi Node Tensor Parallelism
summary:
Version 0.9.0 of the llama.cpp library introduces support for native FP8 (OCP E4M3) and enables tensor parallels across multiple nodes via NCCL. The update also includes improved multi-sequence serving and faster prefill speeds for Gemma 4 E2B and E4B models, alongside new compatibility for the Mistral Large 4, Metis-1.6, and Clover models.

The development team said the project is preparing for the launch of version 1.0.0, its first major release, within the next few weeks. The v0.9.0 update also adds speech capabilities to the library, incorporating Chatterbox TTS and Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe.
